title: Coefficient changes commute with $\eta_f$
statement:
Let $a\colon\Lambda\to\Lambda'$ be a morphism of condensed abelian groups (in particular of
condensed rings), $f\colon X\to Y$ a morphism of schemes, and
$\eta_f\colon\Lambda_Y\to f_*\Lambda_X$, $\eta'_f\colon\Lambda'_Y\to f_*\Lambda'_X$ the
coefficient morphisms of [sk-def-sfb-coefficient-morphisms], with $f_*$ the pushforward of
abelian sheaves ([sk-def-sfb-finite-pushforward-pullback]). Then

$$
f_*a_X\circ\eta_f=\eta'_f\circ a_Y\colon\Lambda_Y\longrightarrow f_*\Lambda'_X ,
$$

with $a_X$, $a_Y$ the coefficient changes of [def-sfb-coefficient-map].

proof.text:
By [sk-def-sfb-coefficient-morphisms], $\eta_f$ is the unit $u_{\Lambda_Y}\colon\Lambda_Y\to
f_*f^*\Lambda_Y$ of the adjunction $f^*\dashv f_*$ of
[sk-def-sfb-finite-pushforward-pullback] followed by $f_*\alpha_f$, and likewise for $\eta'_f$.
Hence, using [lem-sfb-coefficient-pullback-square] in the second step and the naturality of the
unit in the third,

$$
f_*a_X\circ\eta_f=f_*(a_X\circ\alpha_f)\circ u_{\Lambda_Y}
=f_*\alpha'_f\circ f_*f^*a_Y\circ u_{\Lambda_Y}
=f_*\alpha'_f\circ u_{\Lambda'_Y}\circ a_Y=\eta'_f\circ a_Y .
$$
